title: Interview scheduling for small recruiting teams
description: Scheduling platforms assume coordinators. Cadence automates interviews end to end for teams of one to five recruiters — GDPR included, free in early access.

faq.q: Is interview scheduling software worth it for a team of one?
faq.a: That is where it pays back fastest. A solo recruiter or hiring founder has no slack for reminder-chasing, no-show recovery, or status-update email — automating the follow-through returns hours every week, and candidates get a faster, more consistent process.

faq.q: What makes small-team scheduling different from enterprise coordination?
faq.a: Enterprise platforms optimize a staffed coordination function: queues, load balancing, analytics. A small team needs the opposite — a tool that runs the whole loop unattended: booking, reminders, no-show defense, status pages, scorecards, and ATS write-back.
